description: This PHP source file defines the Order controller class within the Opencart framework, specifically handling customer order listing, detailed order information, and order history functionalities in the account section. It includes methods for rendering order lists, detailed order views, and order status history, integrating models, views, and routing mechanisms of the framework.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Controller class managing customer order-related actions such as listing orders, viewing order details, and order history within the Opencart account framework.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the customer's order list, including pagination and breadcrumbs setup. Loads necessary models and views to render the order list page.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific order, including addresses, products, status, totals, and history. Handles the case when an order is not found.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the order status history for a specific order, requiring user login validation.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Retrieves and formats the order's history data, including pagination, for display.
